name: ground-route-slots
description: From the title screen, enter the first world and let it settle, then poke a sentinel into the projected X word of ground-extent slot $E8 ($10A8), one of the slots the list at $05499E allocates below $F0, and break on the next write while walking forward. Establishes whether the slots below $F0 are filled by the same $054A64 projector as the recovered $F0/$F4 scene joins (#281).
